verses.original: Ὑπομίμνῃσκε αὐτοὺς ἀρχαῖς ἐξουσίαις ὑποτάσσεσθαι πειθαρχεῖν πρὸς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἑτοίμους εἶναι
verses.transliteration: Hypomimnēske autous archais exousiais hypotassesthai peitharchein pros pan ergon agathon hetoimous einai
verses.literal: Remind the believers to submit to rulers and authorities to be obedient and ready for every good work
verses.literalPt: Adverte-lhes que estejam sujeitos aos governadores e às autoridades; que sejam obedientes, que estejam prontos para toda boa obra;

verses.original: μηδένα βλασφημεῖν ἀμάχους εἶναι ἐπιεικεῖς πᾶσαν ἐνδεικνυμένους πραΰτητα πρὸς πάντας ἀνθρώπους
verses.transliteration: mēdena blasphēmein amachous einai epieikeis pasan endeiknymenous prautēta pros pantas anthrōpous
verses.literal: to malign no one and to be peaceable and gentle showing full consideration to everyone . . .
verses.literalPt: que não digam mal de ninguém, nem sejam questionadores, mas que sejam sossegados, mostrando toda mansidão para com todos.

verses.original: Ἦμεν γάρ ποτε καὶ ἡμεῖς ἀνόητοι ἀπειθεῖς πλανώμενοι δουλεύοντες ἐπιθυμίαις καὶ ἡδοναῖς ποικίλαις ἐν κακίᾳ καὶ φθόνῳ διάγοντες στυγητοί μισοῦντες ἀλλήλους
verses.transliteration: Ēmen gar pote kai hēmeis anoētoi apeitheis planōmenoi douleuontes epithymiais kai hēdonais poikilais en kakia kai phthonō diagontes stygētoi misountes allēlous
verses.literal: For at one time we too were foolish disobedient misled and enslaved to all sorts of desires and pleasures living in malice and envy being hated and hating one another
verses.literalPt: Pois nós também éramos, outrora, insensatos, desobedientes, desviados, escravos de várias cobiças e deleites, vivendo em malícia e inveja, odiosos e aborrecendo-nos uns aos outros.

verses.original: Ὅτε δὲ ἡ χρηστότης καὶ ἡ φιλανθρωπία ἐπεφάνη τοῦ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hote de hē chrēstotēs kai hē philanthrōpia epephanē tou Sōtēros hēmōn Theou
verses.literal: But when the kindness of God our Savior and His love for mankind appeared
verses.literalPt: Mas, quando apareceu a bondade de Deus, nosso Salvador, e o seu amor para com os homens,

verses.original: οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων τῶν ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ ἃ ἐποιήσαμεν ἡμεῖς ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὸ αὐτοῦ ἔλεος ἔσωσεν ἡμᾶς διὰ λουτροῦ παλινγενεσίας καὶ ἀνακαινώσεως Πνεύματος Ἁγίου
verses.transliteration: ouk ex ergōn tōn en dikaiosynē ha epoiēsamen hēmeis alla kata to autou eleos esōsen hēmas dia loutrou palingenesias kai anakainōseōs Pneumatos Hagiou
verses.literal: He saved us not by the righteous deeds - we had done but according to His mercy through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit
verses.literalPt: não por obras de justiça que nós fizemos, mas segundo a sua misericórdia nos salvou, pelo lavatório da regeneração e renovação do Espírito Santo,

verses.original: οὗ ἐξέχεεν ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς πλουσίως διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: hou execheen eph’ hēmas plousiōs dia Iēsou Christou tou Sōtēros hēmōn
verses.literal: This is the Spirit He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior
verses.literalPt: que ele derramou sobre nós abundantemente por Jesus Cristo, nosso Salvador,

verses.original: ἵνα δικαιωθέντες τῇ ἐκείνου χάριτι κληρονόμοι γενηθῶμεν κατ’ ἐλπίδα ζωῆς αἰωνίου
verses.transliteration: hina dikaiōthentes tē ekeinou chariti klēronomoi genēthōmen kat’ elpida zōēs aiōniou
verses.literal: so that having been justified by His grace we would become heirs with the hope of eternal life
verses.literalPt: a fim de que, justificados pela sua graça, fôssemos feitos herdeiros segundo a esperança da vida eterna.

verses.original: Πιστὸς ὁ λόγος καὶ περὶ τούτων βούλομαί σε διαβεβαιοῦσθαι ἵνα φροντίζωσιν καλῶν ἔργων προΐστασθαι οἱ πεπιστευκότες Θεῷ ταῦτά ἐστιν καλὰ καὶ ὠφέλιμα τοῖς ἀνθρώποις
verses.transliteration: Pistos ho logos kai peri toutōn boulomai se diabebaiousthai hina phrontizōsin kalōn ergōn proistasthai hoi pepisteukotes Theō tauta estin kala kai ōphelima tois anthrōpois
verses.literal: This saying is trustworthy And I want you to emphasize . . . these things so that those who have believed God will take care to devote themselves to good deeds These things are excellent and profitable for the people
verses.literalPt: Fiel é essa palavra, e quero que isso afirmes confiadamente, a fim de que os que tiverem crido a Deus sejam cuidadosos em praticarem as boas obras. Isso é bom e útil aos homens.

verses.original: Μωρὰς δὲ ζητήσεις καὶ γενεαλογίας καὶ ἔρεις καὶ μάχας νομικὰς περιΐστασο εἰσὶν γὰρ ἀνωφελεῖς καὶ μάταιοι
verses.transliteration: Mōras de zētēseis kai genealogias kai ereis kai machas nomikas periistaso eisin gar anōpheleis kai mataioi
verses.literal: But avoid foolish controversies genealogies arguments and quarrels about the law because these things are pointless and worthless
verses.literalPt: Mas evita questões tolas, genealogias, contendas e disputas relativas à Lei, pois elas são inúteis e vãs.

verses.original: αἱρετικὸν ἄνθρωπον μετὰ μίαν καὶ δευτέραν νουθεσίαν παραιτοῦ
verses.transliteration: hairetikon anthrōpon meta mian kai deuteran nouthesian paraitou
verses.literal: Reject a divisive man after a first and second admonition
verses.literalPt: Evita o homem faccioso, depois de o teres advertido primeira e segunda vez,

verses.original: εἰδὼς ὅτι ἐξέστραπται ὁ τοιοῦτος καὶ ἁμαρτάνει ὢν αὐτοκατάκριτος
verses.transliteration: eidōs hoti exestraptai ho toioutos kai hamartanei ōn autokatakritos
verses.literal: knowing that such a man is corrupt and sinful he is self-condemned
verses.literalPt: sabendo que o que é tal é pervertido e peca, sendo condenado por si mesmo.

verses.original: Ὅταν πέμψω Ἀρτεμᾶν πρὸς σὲ ἢ Τυχικόν σπούδασον ἐλθεῖν πρός με εἰς Νικόπολιν ἐκεῖ γὰρ κέκρικα παραχειμάσαι
verses.transliteration: Hotan pempsō Arteman pros se ē Tychikon spoudason elthein pros me eis Nikopolin ekei gar kekrika paracheimasai
verses.literal: As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus to you make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis because I have decided to winter there
verses.literalPt: Quando eu enviar Ártemas ou Tíquico a ti, procura vir ter comigo a Nicópolis, porque tenho resolvido passar ali o inverno.

verses.original: Ζηνᾶν τὸν νομικὸν καὶ Ἀπολλῶν σπουδαίως πρόπεμψον ἵνα μηδὲν αὐτοῖς λείπῃ
verses.transliteration: Zēnan ton nomikon kai Apollōn spoudaiōs propempson hina mēden autois leipē
verses.literal: Do your best to equip Zenas the lawyer and Apollos so that they will have everything they need . . .
verses.literalPt: Ajuda a Zenas, doutor da lei, e a Apolo na sua viagem, para que nada lhes falte.

verses.original: μανθανέτωσαν δὲ καὶ οἱ ἡμέτεροι καλῶν ἔργων προΐστασθαι εἰς τὰς ἀναγκαίας χρείας ἵνα μὴ ὦσιν ἄκαρποι
verses.transliteration: manthanetōsan de kai hoi hēmeteroi kalōn ergōn proistasthai eis tas anankaias chreias hina mē ōsin akarpoi
verses.literal: And our people must also learn to devote themselves to good works in order to meet the pressing needs of others so that they will not be unfruitful
verses.literalPt: Que os nossos aprendam a ser os primeiros a praticar boas obras para as coisas que são necessárias, a fim de que não sejam infrutuosos.

verses.original: Ἀσπάζονταί σε οἱ μετ’ ἐμοῦ πάντες Ἄσπασαι τοὺς φιλοῦντας ἡμᾶς ἐν πίστει Ἡ χάρις μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Aspazontai se hoi met’ emou pantes Aspasai tous philountas hēmas en pistei Hē charis meta pantōn hymōn
verses.literal: All who are with me send you greetings . . . Greet those who love us in the faith Grace be with all of you
verses.literalPt: Todos os que estão comigo te saúdam. Saúda àqueles que nos amam na fé. A graça seja com todos vós.
